rationale: The candidate is internally consistent and well supported by executed evidence. (1) Source coverage is complete: all five scientific branches of the original notebook — A (open/closed rms.rmsd value), B (universe-level backbone RMSD with CORE/LID/NMP groupselections), C (AtomGroup CORE alpha-carbon), D (mass-weighted), E (resid-weighted) — are present as graded endpoints. The two endpoints the preparation plan excluded (overwritten R/df; the never-assigned single value) were restored exactly as the endpoint_recovery policy permits: the derive script reruns the unchanged original RMSD/rmsd calls on the byte-identical hash-verified inputs with fresh universes positioned at frame 0, hashes match the independently executed oracle, and the recomputed control passes. The dropped Time (ns) reader-metadata column is an explicit allowed projection, not a dropped result, and extra columns are ignored by the public contract anyway; the notebook plots are visualizations of the same result sets already exported as CSVs. (2) The public addendum matches the grader exactly: one structural check (paths resolved directly under the submission root with no fallback search — the misplaced outputs/ layer correctly fails per the misplaced control; column presence/uniqueness/case; integer unique Frame keys; key-set equality across files 1-4 and versus the reference 0-97 set; single-row endpoint; finite parseable cells; ragged/BOM/garbage handling) plus five per-branch checks joined on Frame, all against the tolerance |v - v_ref| <= 5e-6 Å + 1e-6*|v_ref| defined with an explicit, measurement-grounded basis and a public low-precision pitfall warning. (3) Controls: all 16 executed records match the control summary; reference, recomputed (oracle), alternative (independent NumPy Kabsch implementation, MDAnalysis used only for parsing), empty, misplaced, five per-file missing and six probe controls all produced their intended outcomes, with probe effects established by controller before/after hashes. The D definition (mass-weighted groupselection domain RMSDs after the single alpha-carbon superposition) matches the executed reference (mass CORE/LID/NMP differ measurably from the unweighted backbone branch) and the independent implementation, corroborated by the passing alternative control and the mass-vs-resid probe failing 388/392 cells; the notebook's contrary prose is recorded, not propagated. (4) The probe repair is legitimate: initial vs. current probes differ only in expected check IDs (removing the internally inconsistent structural_schema expectation from wrong_solution probes, confirmed by the executed reports where structural_schema passes), rationale rewording that accurately describes value-perturbation stand-ins and the one faithful wrong-method substitution (D), and concern cleanup; mutation scripts and overall fail outcomes are unchanged and were executed fresh on the current candidate (author-side summary 16/16 after the earlier 11/16). No answer leakage, no hardcoded values in the grader, no control-name detection, no tolerance accommodating an executed wrong method: the smallest executed wrong-method deviation (~0.03 Å for the x1.01 CORE scaling in the analysis-B probe) is ~3 orders of magnitude above the ~1e-5 Å boundary, and the tolerance boundary itself was exercised from below by the valid %.15g re-serialization (max deviation ~8.9e-15 Å over every compared cell). Remaining items are recorded in remaining_validation rather than unresolved defects: Harbor's own isolation/oracle checks on this candidate, administrative input-redistribution clearance for the LGPL-2.1 MDAnalysisTests data files (already flagged by the candidate), and cross-stack/single-precision portability, which was not measured and is not promised (software choice open, no universal-portability claim made). Advisory observations that require no change: the independent solution's frozen rationale misstates domain backbone atom counts (411/152/135-style error) as corrected by its own executed asserts (855 total; CORE 583 / LID 152 / NMP 120), a false prose claim recorded in the repair rationale with no effect on any public contract, grader logic, reference value or executed control outcome; and the duplicate-Frame-key / cross-file key-mismatch failure paths, while implemented, deterministic and public, were not exercised by a dedicated probe (only the misplaced/empty/per-file-missing and valid-representation controls establish the surrounding structure enforcement).

source_coverage.rationale: Audited the original notebook, preparation plan and export code against the graded task. The notebook has five terminal scientific branches: the standalone open-vs-closed backbone rms.rmsd value (A), the universe-level backbone-fit RMSD with CORE/LID/NMP groupselections (B), the AtomGroup-restricted CORE alpha-carbon RMSD (C), the mass-weighted branch (D) and the resid-weighted branch (E). All five are required and graded by the public task, with all 98 frames and frame 0 as trajectory reference for B-E; no branch of the original source is omitted. The preparation inventory originally excluded A and B via the no-recovery rule (R and df overwritten by the later AtomGroup branch; the single value never assigned). Under the current endpoint_recovery policy these two endpoints were restored by faithful recomputation of the unchanged original source calls on byte-identical, hash-verified inputs with the required state (fresh universes created via mda.Universe(psf, dcd), so the standalone rmsd call reads frame-0 positions before any iteration, matching the notebook execution order); the derive script ran to exit 0, and the recovered values are independently corroborated by both the oracle run and the independent NumPy Kabsch implementation (recomputed and alternative controls both pass all cells). This restoration is a reconstruction of an unchanged original scientific result, not a scope change: no method, argument, selection, input or compared value differs from the original source. The three weighted/CA CSVs are projections of the recorded reference exports retaining only the publicly compared columns; the frame inventory 0-97 and cell values were verified unchanged and only the reader-guessed Time (ns) metadata column is dropped, which is an allowed projection of non-scientific metadata rather than a discarded result (the notebook plots are visualizations of these same result sets and introduce no additional terminal values). No supplied intermediates compete with an independent endpoint: the projected CSVs are the reference outputs themselves and give no shortcut for A or B. The public D definition of mass-weighted domain RMSDs after the single alpha-carbon superposition is a fidelity-to-execution clarification rather than a scope change: it follows the executed MDAnalysis 2.11.0 default weights_groupselections behavior that the frozen reference embodies (mass-branch domain values differ measurably from the unweighted backbone branch, corroborated by the passing independent implementation and the mass-vs-resid probe failing 388/392 cells), and the notebook's contrary narrative is recorded, not propagated. Reference structural profiles confirm 98 rows with Frame 0-97 and finite values in all compared columns of every file, matching the public contract. All defect lists are empty.
